app.name: LetZeusPost
app.description: On-brand social posts for agencies, in English and Bangla.

switcher.note: Each workspace is separate: brands, posts and notifications never mix.
switcher.loadError: Couldn’t load your workspaces. Check your connection and try again.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.intro: Enter your email and a sign-in link will be sent to you. It works once, for 10 minutes.
signIn.emailHint: Use the address you were invited with.
signIn.linkProblem: This is a used or expired link. Links work once, for 10 minutes. Ask for a new one below.

sent.heading: Check your email
sent.body: If {email} has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for 10 minutes.
sent.spam: Nothing there after a minute? Look in your spam folder.

errors.invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address. Check it and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many links were asked for. Wait an hour, then try again.
errors.unknownClient: This request couldn’t be checked because it didn’t come through letzeuspost.com. Open LetZeusPost from that address and try again, or email hello@letzeuspost.com if it keeps happening.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach LetZeusPost. Check your connection and try again.

home.heading: Welcome to LetZeusPost
home.body: The app is still being built. Sign-in comes next.
